info.name: Cyfuture DBaaS - Projects and All Database Engines
info.description:
Complete project-scoped DBaaS API collection for PostgreSQL, MySQL and MongoDB provisioning in every currently supported deployment mode.

Async operations return a small 202 Accepted body with operationId, databaseId, status, statusUrl and suggestedPollingIntervalSeconds. Poll statusUrl until terminal=true and status is SUCCEEDED or FAILED. Operation polling is read-only and must not be used to trigger provisioning, shared-gateway rollout or allowlist changes.

Breaking frontend response changes: database list/status responses omit privateEndpoint, namespace, backend readiness counters and allowedCidrs; operation responses omit project/stage/progress; connection responses omit privateEndpoint and privateConnectionUri. Credentials are only returned by the connection endpoint. Errors return code, message, fieldErrors and requestId. Retry DATABASE_NOT_READY, 502 and 503 with backoff; reuse an Idempotency-Key only for the same request body.
